Type:        REFORMAT
Name:        Map
Category:    transformers
Description: Receives data through connected input port, transforms them in a user specified way, and sends such new outgoing data records to all connected output ports. Implements org.jetel.component.RecordTransform interface.
Usage:       When to use: 1->1 transformation where each input record produces one (modified, enriched, or restructured) output record. Primary use is to transform data structure or content between input and output metadata. Optionally, can produce records on different output ports to support routing or different output structures; return a port number (or ALL) to control routing.
             Constraints: Not intended for data-driven record expansion or aggregation across multiple input records. Use NORMALIZER when multiple output records per input are required. Use DENORMALIZER when a single output record should be created from a group of multiple input records.

Input Ports:
  [0] (required)
Output Ports:
  [*] (min 1 required)

Properties:
  Conditional required groups:
    transform | transformClass | transformURL (at least one is required; mutually exclusive)

  transform [attr-cdata]: [transform]  Defines the transformation logic used to convert input records to output records.
  transformURL: [file]  Specifies the path to an external file containing the transformation logic.
  transformClass: [class]  Specifies the Java class that implements the transformation logic.
  charset: [charset]  Defines the character encoding used to encode/decode file content. If not specified, the system will attempt to detect or use the default encoding.
  errorActions [attr-cdata]: [errorActions]  Defines the actions to take when errors occur during processing.
  errorLog: [file]  Specifies the file where error information should be logged.

To configure it, call component_get_guide("REFORMAT") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
